Generate Reaction Events for the RRMS DES Model

gen_react_events.Rd

Defines the model's response to each event, specifying how patient state variables, costs, utilities, and future events are updated when an event occurs. Returns a WARDEN add_reactevt() chain consumed by run_sim_new via the evt_react_list argument in rrmsdesmodel.

Usage

gen_react_events(RRMS_events)

Arguments

RRMS_events

Character vector of model event names, passed from v_event_names set by rrmsdessetup. Must match the events initialised in gen_init_events.

Value

A WARDEN add_reactevt() chain object containing reaction logic for all events in RRMS_events, passed to run_sim_new via the evt_react_list argument in rrmsdesmodel.

Details

Each event reaction is defined using add_reactevt. All reaction events update utilities_disease and costs_disease at each event time using the EDSS-specific utility and cost.

The following reaction events are defined:

initialise

Sets current_treatment and current_treatment_code to the arm being simulated. Adjusts the death event time to be relative to model entry and caps it at time_horizon. Schedules the first annual_treatment event.

age

Updates age and refreshes utilities_disease and costs_disease for the current EDSS state.

annual_treatment

Increments years_on_treatment by 1 and updates the treatment-line time counter (t_2ndline, t_3rdline, or t_4thline) for RRMS patients on treatment. Schedules the next annual_treatment event one year ahead if edss_value <= 6.

Applies instantaneous treatment acquisition, administration, and monitoring costs (costs_treatment) conditional on treatment year and SPMS status,costs are scaled by the treatment load factor. relapse

Increments n_relapse by 1. Applies instantaneous relapse disutilities and relapse costs. Schedules the next relapse using the same exponential draw from an exponential distribution using baseline log-rate for HARRMS patients modified by the treatment-specific ARR rate ratio from the NMA.

edss_increase

Increments edss_value by 1, capped at (EDSS 9). Increments n_edssinc_evts by 1. Sets treatment_stop <- 1 if edss_value > 6 and treatment has not already stopped — this triggers the cessation of treatment cost accrual and applies placebo hazard ratios to future events. Schedules the next edss_increase event drawn from an exponential distribution using baseline log-rate for HARRMS patients modified by the treatment-specific CDP6 hazard ratio from the NMA.

edss_decrease

Decrements edss_value by 1, floored at (EDSS 0). Increments n_edssdec_evts by 1. Checks and sets treatment_stop as in edss_increase. Schedules the next edss_decrease event drawn from an exponential distribution for patients.

progression

Sets spms_flag <- 1, converting the patient from RRMS to SPMS. Progression can only occur once; no new progression event is scheduled. Immediately updates utilities_disease and costs_disease to SPMS values for the current EDSS state. Only applies to patients with edss_value > 4.

death

Sets curtime <- Inf, ending the patient's simulation. Updates utilities_disease and costs_disease for the final EDSS state. No new events are scheduled. Death can only occur once.

serious_adverse_event

Increments n_sae_evts by 1. Applies the SAE disutility and SAE costs. Schedules the next SAE' Drawn from an exponential distribution using the baseline SAE rate modified by the treatment-specific SAE hazard ratio from the NMA .

treatment_switch

Increments treatment_line by 1 and n_switch by 1. Marks the current treatment as used in v_prior_treatment_indices. Resets years_on_treatment to 0.

New treatment selection logic:

  • First switch (n_switch == 1): samples from available higher-line treatments (excluding current and prior treatments), weighted by proportion of patients on 3rd line from the registry.

  • Second or later switch (n_switch >= 2): samples uniformly from remaining available treatments.

The discontinuation rate is updated to reflect the protocol assumption that patients switch at most twice (starting from 2nd line, reaching 4th line as the final option). Schedules the next treatment_switch event drawn from an exponential distribution using the baseline discontinuation hazard modified by the treatment-specific discontinuation hazard ratios.
